# AbiPaint

> AbiPaint is a free, browser-based photo editor. No install, no sign-up required. Resize images, draw with brush and shape tools, add text, and adjust exposure, contrast, and saturation directly in the browser.

Built by Abiting, who has run a Detective Conan fan site for years and needed
a fast way to resize images and adjust colors without paying for Adobe or
signing up for Canva.

## Pages

- [Traditional Chinese version](https://abipaint.abiting.cc/): Primary interface
- [English version](https://abipaint.abiting.cc/en): English interface

## Features

- Resize images to custom or preset dimensions (business cards, social media, etc.)
- Brush, shape, and text tools with up to 5 layers and undo/redo
- Exposure, contrast, and saturation adjustment
- Free export, no account required

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://abipaint.abiting.cc/sitemap.xml)
